summary: NYC DOE opposes eliminating E‑Rate, urges preservation of core purpose, argues broadband availability alone does not negate need, calls for discount based on economic need not geography, and opposes federal screen‑time conditions. NYC DOE urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate funding, maintain objective need metrics, avoid urban‑status cuts, not tie funding to screen‑time limits, and respect existing state/local policies.
